title: Agent file put
description: What agent.file_put takes: a file to write in an agent's workspace.

path.description: The file's path in the workspace, such as skills/triage/SKILL.md.

content.description: The file's text, at most 4 MiB.

version.description: The version to write over, from agent.file or agent.files.
